description: WebMCP Retail demo — accessories store with WebMCP + AG-UI custom agent support

tools.name: login
tools.title: Login
tools.description: Signs the user in via PingOne by navigating THIS TAB to the sign-in flow. Use when a person is present and can see this tab (companion agent in the user's browser, or a visible browser you control). Ask the user for their account email address in chat first, then pass it as the email parameter; the user completes out-of-band verification (e.g. approving on their phone) and the app reloads signed in. WARNING: do not call from a headless or ephemeral automation context — navigation unloads the tab and you lose it; use ciba_login instead. Only usable when signed out.

email.description: The user's email address — ask the user for it in chat before calling this tool.

tools.name: view_products
tools.title: View Products
tools.description: Fetches the product catalog from the backend API. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add to Cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the shopping cart by product ID and quantity.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: View Cart
tools.description: Returns the current cart contents and total as JSON. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.title: Remove from Cart
tools.description: Removes a product entirely from the cart by product ID. Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.

tools.name: checkout
tools.title: Checkout
tools.description: POSTs the cart to the checkout API using the user's access_token as a Bearer credential. The host prompts the user for confirmation (consequentialHint) before this tool runs. If the policy requires step-up, the tab navigates to the PingOne OOB verification flow (user approves on their device); the app then returns with the cart intact — call this tool again to place the order. Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.
